FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

New York fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older need a freshwater licence. Marine fishing uses a free registry, which also covers certain migratory fish in inland rivers.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Freshwater anglers aged 16 or older.
  • Marine anglers aged 16 or older, including those targeting specified migratory marine fish inland.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16.
  • 2026 freshwater free days listed in the current guide: June 27–28, September 26, and November 11.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 1-daynon resident1 day$10 USD
Non-resident 7-daynon resident7 days$28 USD
Non-resident annualnon resident365 days$50 USD
Recreational Marine Fishing Registryany365 days$0 USD

Saltwater

The free marine registry applies in the Marine and Coastal District and for listed migratory marine species in state waters.

Rules visitors should know

  • All other fishing rules remain in effect on free fishing days.
  • The marine registry can apply on the Hudson and Delaware rivers.

How to buy

Obtain a licence or marine registration through DEC licence sales or a licence-issuing agent.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in New York?

Anglers aged 16 or older need a freshwater licence. Marine fishing uses a free registry, which also covers certain migratory fish in inland rivers.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in New York?

Non-resident 1-day: $10 USD; Non-resident 7-day: $28 USD; Non-resident annual: $50 USD; Recreational Marine Fishing Registry: $0 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in New York?

Obtain a licence or marine registration through DEC licence sales or a licence-issuing agent.
